referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set accounts for 1 kg of gravel at the regional storage. 19% are from import, 81% are produced in Switzerland. The imported goods are delievered to Switzerland to 36% from Germany, 26% from Italy 23% from France and 14% from Austria. 13% are delievered by freight train, 78% by lorry and 8% by barge. The resource correction for recycled sand (assumed share: 90%) is also included.
